title: Website Classification Rules

rules.condition: Customer wants an informational business presence.
rules.action: Consider corporate or business website classification.

rules.condition: Customer intends to sell products online.
Customer connects two or more participant groups.
Customer requires users to request or schedule services.
rules.action: Consider booking or service website classification.

rules.condition: Customer requires authenticated users to perform ongoing tasks.
rules.action: Consider web application or portal classification.

rules.condition: Customer wants to change the appearance but preserve functionality.
rules.action: Classify as visual redesign provisionally and audit existing functionality.

rules.condition: Customer wants to change the implementation technology.
rules.action: Consider technical rebuild or platform migration.
Apply multiple classification labels and identify primary and secondary purposes.

prohibitions: Do not invent the number of locations, customers, users, or products.
Do not infer live functionality from visual appearance alone.
Do not classify a website as compliant based on its category.
Do not finalize technology decisions from website type alone.
